stories.title: McGraw Hill ( MH ) Q2 2027 Earnings Call Transcript
stories.summary: McGraw Hill reported its fiscal Q2 2027 results, highlighting a shift toward digital and recurring revenue streams, which now represent 60% and 71% of the business mix respectively. The company also announced the acquisitions of TeachFX and Teachally to bolster its AI-driven curriculum and coaching capabilities.
stories.why_it_matters: The results demonstrate the company's successful transition to a digital-first, recurring revenue model. Strategic investments in AI, including partnerships with Microsoft and Anthropic, and the acquisition of specialized edtech firms position the company for a projected growth inflection in fiscal year 2028.
verified_facts: Total revenue for fiscal Q2 2027 was $632.2 million.
Acquired TeachFX for $24.0 million and Teachally for $5.2 million.
Robin Lucas appointed as President of Higher Education and Jana Thompson as President of K-12.
Digital revenue increased 5.6% year over year in the first half of fiscal 2027.

drafts.concise: McGraw Hill has released its fiscal Q2 2027 earnings, reporting a strategic pivot toward digital and recurring revenue models. Digital revenue grew 5.6% year-over-year in the first half, supported by over 100 million active curriculum licenses globally. The company also announced the acquisitions of TeachFX and Teachally to enhance its AI-enabled teaching tools. Additionally, the firm confirmed leadership changes, appointing Robin Lucas as President of Higher Education and Jana Thompson as President of K-12. These developments reflect a continued focus on operational efficiency and the integration of advanced AI technologies across their K-12 and higher education portfolios as they prepare for the upcoming English Language Arts market cycle. #McGrawHill #EdTech #FinancialResults
drafts.investor: McGraw Hill’s Q2 2027 results underscore the strength of its transition to a recurring revenue model, which now accounts for 71% of the business mix. With $632.2 million in quarterly revenue and a robust Remaining Performance Obligation of $1.791 billion, the company is demonstrating clear revenue visibility. Management is actively scaling its AI capabilities through partnerships with Microsoft and Anthropic, alongside the strategic acquisitions of TeachFX and Teachally. These investments, combined with a disciplined approach to debt reduction—totalling $700 million since the IPO—position the company for a multiyear growth inflection in fiscal 2028. The firm remains focused on margin expansion and capturing share in the evolving education market. #Investment #GrowthStrategy #Education
drafts.people: We are pleased to note the leadership appointments at McGraw Hill as they continue to execute their long-term growth strategy. Robin Lucas has been named President of Higher Education, and Jana Thompson has been appointed President of K-12. These appointments come at a pivotal time for the company as it integrates agentic AI into its curriculum offerings and prepares for the upcoming K-12 English Language Arts super-cycle. With over 100 million active curriculum licenses globally, the company continues to rely on strong leadership to drive pedagogical trust and digital adoption. We look forward to seeing the impact of these appointments on the company’s continued innovation in the global education sector. #Leadership #Education #Management

stories.title: McGraw Hill Integrates Trusted Content into AI Platform Developed by University of California, San Francisco School of Medicine - Yahoo Finance
stories.summary: McGraw Hill has announced a strategic partnership with the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) School of Medicine to integrate its educational content into a new AI-driven learning platform.
stories.why_it_matters: This collaboration highlights McGraw Hill's ongoing transition into the edtech space, leveraging its proprietary, trusted content to enhance AI-powered medical education tools, which represents a significant growth area for the business.
verified_facts: McGraw Hill is integrating content into a UCSF School of Medicine AI platform.
The announcement was published on 2 November 2026.

drafts.concise: We are pleased to share that McGraw Hill has entered into a strategic collaboration with the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) School of Medicine. By integrating its trusted educational content into a new AI-powered platform developed by UCSF, McGraw Hill continues to advance its digital learning capabilities. This partnership underscores the company's commitment to supporting medical education through high-quality, verified resources in an evolving technological landscape. #EdTech #McGrawHill #DigitalLearning
drafts.investor: McGraw Hill’s latest partnership with the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) School of Medicine marks a strategic step in the company’s digital transformation. By embedding its proprietary content into UCSF’s AI-driven medical education platform, McGraw Hill is effectively scaling its reach within the high-value professional and medical learning sectors. This initiative demonstrates the commercial potential of leveraging established intellectual property to power next-generation AI tools, reinforcing the company's position as a leader in the global edtech market. #EducationTechnology #Innovation #GrowthStrategy
drafts.people: Congratulations to the team at McGraw Hill on their new partnership with the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) School of Medicine. This collaboration sees McGraw Hill’s trusted content integrated into a sophisticated AI platform designed to support medical students. It is a testament to the team's ongoing efforts to modernise learning experiences and ensure that high-quality, reliable information remains at the heart of medical training. A significant milestone in the company's digital evolution. #McGrawHill #MedicalEducation #AI

The company reports service delays in Europe, the Middle East, the Americas, and Oceania due to factors including customs checks, flooding, and geopolitical conflict.

stories.title: International UnTracked Updates
stories.summary: The Delivery Group has issued an operational update regarding international delivery services, highlighting ongoing transit delays in the Middle East, Argentina, Italy, North Macedonia, and Panama due to geopolitical, environmental, and infrastructure factors.
stories.why_it_matters: Maintaining transparency regarding global supply chain disruptions is critical for logistics providers to manage client expectations and demonstrate operational resilience in a complex international environment.
verified_facts: The Delivery Group is reporting potential delays for shipments to Iran, Israel, Iraq, Qatar, UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, and Oman.
Runway restrictions at Argentina's Ministro Pistarini International Airport are affecting cargo until 11 November 2026.
Operations at the North Macedonia Post sorting centre in Skopje were impacted by a power cut on 19 October 2026.
warnings: This is a service update rather than a corporate milestone; it is intended for operational transparency rather than investor relations.
The information provided is highly fluid and subject to change based on external global events.

sector_stories.angle: Increased regulatory friction and costs for cross-border e-commerce impact delivery operations, client compliance, and potential parcel volumes.

sector_stories.title: Logistics UK: International companies invest in countries where goods move efficiently

sector_stories.title: December remains the peak month for parcel theft
sector_stories.summary: UK police reports of parcel theft rose by 87% in the last year, with December remaining the peak month for incidents.

sector_stories.title: This peak DPD to have “more electric vans delivering on the road than ever before”

sector_stories.title: New tools to support preparation for Martyn’s Law

sector_stories.title: Delays as local authorities prepare for Martyn’s Law

sector_stories.title: Future proofing intruder alarm systems

sector_stories.title: SNE Research: Chinese OEMs increasingly dominate global EV battery market

sector_stories.title: Flanders Introduces Seven Cost-Effective QD-OLED Monitors

sector_stories.summary: The Packaging Data Hub reports that only 18% of plastic packaging is recycled globally, highlighting significant gaps in collection and processing infrastructure across 50 markets.
sector_stories.angle: Provides critical benchmarking data on global recycling rates and infrastructure efficacy for plastic packaging sustainability strategies.

sector_stories.title: OpenAI deal to cut Abu Dhabi government processing times from days to minutes
sector_stories.summary: Abu Dhabi has partnered with OpenAI to deploy frontier AI models locally, aiming to become an AI-native government by 2027 while maintaining data sovereignty and intellectual property control.

sector_stories.summary: The government has launched a pilot scheme targeting 500 prolific retail offenders with tougher restrictions, including Criminal Behaviour Orders and intensive supervision, to reduce shop theft.

sector_stories.angle: National Lottery services are a key footfall driver for independent retail chains during the critical Christmas trading period.

sector_stories.title: States Make Progress on Outcomes-Based Higher Education
sector_stories.summary: The 2026 Strada State Opportunities Index reports that US states are increasingly prioritising outcomes-based higher education, with significant improvements in work-based learning, career coaching, and data infrastructure.
sector_stories.angle: Shift toward outcomes-based education and data-driven employability metrics impacts curriculum design and digital learning resource requirements.

sector_stories.title: As 3-Year Degrees Proliferate, Some Pioneers Face Roadblocks
sector_stories.summary: Higher education institutions are increasingly launching three-year bachelor's degree programs, though widespread adoption is currently hindered by limited public awareness and marketing challenges.
sector_stories.angle: Shift toward accelerated degree models impacts curriculum design, textbook demand, and digital learning resource requirements.

sector_stories.title: What Is the Purpose of College in the Age of AI?
sector_stories.summary: University of Virginia dean Christa Acampora discusses how AI integration in higher education necessitates a shift from teaching technical skills to fostering human judgment, intellectual agency, and personal formation.
sector_stories.angle: Highlights the strategic shift in higher education curricula and assessment models as AI disrupts traditional learning and career preparation.

sector_stories.title: Urgent Agenda Item for Democrats: Save the U.S. Department of Education
sector_stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Education faces potential restructuring or elimination efforts by the current administration, with upcoming congressional shifts expected to influence the agency's future operations and funding.
sector_stories.angle: Federal oversight, funding, and research mandates directly impact the regulatory environment and market stability for education publishers.

sector_stories.title: IVF works more quickly than IUI for patients with unexplained infertility
sector_stories.summary: A University of Auckland study found that IVF leads to live births faster than IUI for couples with unexplained infertility, though both methods show similar long-term success rates.
sector_stories.angle: Provides clinical evidence influencing treatment pathways and patient counselling for fertility clinics regarding IUI versus IVF protocols.

sector_stories.title: Under the Influence: Fertility, Advertising and Social Media
sector_stories.summary: A panel of experts discussed how social media misinformation and targeted advertising increasingly shape patient understanding of fertility treatments, often creating unrealistic expectations and anxiety.
sector_stories.angle: Clinicians face a growing need to counter online misinformation and provide evidence-based guidance to patients.

sector_stories.title: IVF add-ons: What information do patients want?
sector_stories.summary: A study in Human Reproduction identifies that patients primarily value live birth rates when evaluating IVF add-ons, while also considering costs and potential regret.
sector_stories.angle: Provides critical insights into patient decision-making and communication priorities regarding elective IVF treatment add-ons.

sector_stories.title: When our embryos were labelled 'abnormal', we lost the right to choose
sector_stories.summary: A qualitative study highlights patient distress and ethical concerns regarding the use of PGT-A to categorically refuse the transfer of embryos labelled as abnormal.
sector_stories.angle: Highlights growing clinical and ethical debate over PGT-A protocols, potentially necessitating policy reviews regarding embryo transfer and informed consent.
